title: My Boss Made Me Train My Replacement… Then He Saw His Offer Letter
hook: My boss made me train the guy replacing me…
story: My boss made me train my own replacement, and he forgot to tell my replacement that part. On Monday, my manager introduced me to a new guy and said, "Show him everything you do." Then he pulled me aside and said I'd be "transitioning out" at the end of the month. I'd worked there four years. I had two choices. I could do a bad job training him, or I could do a great one. I did a great one. I showed him every system, every client, every shortcut. He was nice. Really nice. On Wednesday, at lunch, he asked me why I was leaving. I said, "I'm not leaving. They're replacing me with you." He put his fork down. He said, "They told me the last person quit. They told me you were just helping out." Then he pulled out his offer letter and showed it to me. His salary was almost double mine. For my job. He looked at that letter for a long time. Then he walked into our manager's office and quit on the spot. Without a replacement, and with every client asking for me by name, my manager had no choice. He offered me the job back… at the salary on that offer letter. So now I make double. And every new person who joins the team gets trained by me.
description:
Always train your replacement well. You never know. 💼

New story every day. Subscribe so you don't miss part 2s. 🔔
